referenceAnswer.code:
def solve(data):
    dist=[-1]*data["n"]
    dist[data["start"]]=0
    q=[data["start"]]
    for u in q:
        if u==data["goal"]: return dist[u]
        for a,b in data["edges"]:
            if a==u: v=b
            elif b==u: v=a
            else: continue
            if dist[v]<0:
                dist[v]=dist[u]+1
                q.append(v)
    return -1
